accountPanel.googleLoadFail: Error text under the sign-in form when Google's sign-in script cannot load.
accountPanel.unavailable: Paragraph in the account panel when the server has sign-in switched off.
accountPanel.devPlaceholder: Placeholder of a text box shown only on development servers, where any made-up id signs in.
accountPanel.devLabel: Screen-reader label of the development sign-in text box.
accountPanel.signIn: Button on the sign-in form, the title of the account panel when signed out, and the hover of the person icon.
accountPanel.linkSent: Message under the forgot-password form after the reset email is sent (used when the server gives no text).
accountPanel.recoveryEmail: Placeholder and screen-reader label of the email box, in the forgot-password form, the register form and the signed-in panel.
accountPanel.sendReset: Button in the forgot-password form that emails a password reset link.
accountPanel.back: Button that leaves the forgot-password form or the change-password form.
accountPanel.username: Placeholder and label of the username box.
accountPanel.password: Placeholder and label of the password box.
accountPanel.recoveryEmailOptional: Placeholder of the email box on the create-account form.
accountPanel.createAccount: Button on the sign-in form that opens the create-account form, and the submit button of that form.
accountPanel.signInInstead: Button on the create-account form that goes back to the sign-in form.
accountPanel.forgotPassword: Button on the sign-in form that opens the forgot-password form.
accountPanel.privacy: Link at the bottom of the sign-in form to the privacy page.
accountPanel.terms: Link at the bottom of the sign-in form to the terms page.
accountPanel.signedInAs: Line at the top of the signed-in account panel. name: the account's username, shown in bold, e.g. "anita".
accountPanel.signedInGoogle: Line at the top of the signed-in account panel for an account that signed in through Google.
accountPanel.signedIn: Line at the top of the signed-in account panel when there is no username to show.
accountPanel.passwordChanged: Message in the account panel after the password is changed.
accountPanel.currentPassword: Placeholder and label of the old-password box in the change-password form.
accountPanel.newPassword: Placeholder and label of the new-password box in the change-password form.
accountPanel.save: Submit button of the change-password form.
accountPanel.confirmEmail: Note under the recovery email box while the address is waiting for confirmation. email: the address, e.g. "a@b.com".
accountPanel.noRecoveryEmail: Warning under the recovery email box when the account has none.
accountPanel.saveEmail: Button that saves the recovery email.
accountPanel.remove: Button that removes the recovery email.
accountPanel.changePassword: Button in the signed-in account panel that opens the change-password form.
accountPanel.signOutTip: Hover of the Sign out button. trainsworld and noritetsu are the names of two map sites that share the account; keep them as they are.
accountPanel.signOut: Button in the signed-in account panel.
accountPanel.deleteAccount: Button in the signed-in account panel that opens the delete question, and the button that confirms it.
accountPanel.deleteQuestion: Question in the account panel before deleting the account. noritetsu is the name of a map site.
accountPanel.keepIt: Button in the delete-account question that cancels.
accountPanel.gamesTip: Hover of the games count in the account panel. max: how many games the account may keep, e.g. 20.
accountPanel.gamesCount: Line in the signed-in account panel. count: games saved on the account, e.g. 3.
accountPanel.backupsTip: Hover of the storage figure in the account panel.
accountPanel.storageUsed: Storage used by the account's games. used and limit: sizes from accountPanel.megabytes, e.g. "1.2 MB" and "50 MB".
accountPanel.megabytes: A file size in megabytes. size: a number, e.g. "0.2" or "12".
accountPanel.mergeOne: Question after signing in when one game is stored in this browser only. name: the game's name, e.g. "My network".
accountPanel.mergeMany: Question after signing in when several games are stored in this browser only. count: e.g. 4.
accountPanel.add: Button that adds the browser's games to the account.
accountPanel.dontAdd: Button that declines adding the browser's games to the account.
accountPanel.mergeSure: Second question after declining to add games to the account.
accountPanel.keepHereOne: Button that confirms keeping one game in this browser only.
accountPanel.keepHereMany: Button that confirms keeping several games in this browser only.
accountPanel.addIt: Button that adds one game to the account, after the second question.
accountPanel.addThem: Button that adds several games to the account, after the second question.
accountPanel.account: Title of the account panel when signed in, hover of the person icon, and heading of the Account row in Settings.
accountPanel.accountSettings: Button in Settings that opens the account panel when signed in.
accountPanel.notLoggedIn: Text beside the account icon in Settings and the start menu when signed out.
accountPanel.loggedInAs: Text beside the account icon in Settings. name: the username, e.g. "anita".
accountPanel.loggedInGoogle: Text beside the account icon in Settings for a Google account.
accountPanel.loggedIn: Text beside the account icon in Settings when there is no username.
achievements.title: Hover and screen-reader label of the medal button at the top of the Cities tab that opens the achievements view.
achievements.more: Title of a toast at the map's bottom left when several achievements were earned at once. count: more than 3, e.g. 5.
achievementsView.day: Right-hand figure of a first-achievement row in the achievements view, the game day it was reached. day: the day number, "12".
achievementsView.firstReached: Hover on a reached first-achievement row. text: what was done, a sentence such as "Opened your first line"; when: the date reached, "Mar 4" style as the game words it.
achievementsView.tierReached: Hover on a medal of a tiered achievement that has been reached. text: the tier, such as "Connect 5 cities"; when: the date reached.
achievementsView.title: Title of the achievements view.
allCitiesView.allCities: Lower-case phrase passed to the money hover of the Profit row in the all cities view, naming what the money covers.
allCitiesView.goTo: Hover and screen-reader label of the locate button in the all cities view title.
allCitiesView.tripsTip: Hover on the Train trips row of the all cities view. count: trips per day, "12,430"; where: a trailing phrase starting with a space or empty, such as " in the cities you serve".
blueprint.kindTrack: Heading of a group of rows in the blueprint's cost breakdown.
blueprint.kindStations: Heading of a group of rows in the blueprint's cost breakdown.
blueprint.kindJunctions: Heading of a group of rows in the blueprint's cost breakdown.
blueprint.kindFlyovers: Heading of a group of rows in the blueprint's cost breakdown.
blueprint.kindFlatCrossings: Heading of a group of rows in the blueprint's cost breakdown. A flat crossing is where two tracks cross on the same level.
blueprint.kindTrains: Heading of a group of rows in the blueprint's cost breakdown.
blueprint.kindTerrain: Heading of a group of rows in the blueprint's cost breakdown.
blueprint.kindRoadCrossings: Heading of a group of rows in the blueprint's cost breakdown.
blueprint.kindStationUpgrades: Heading of a group of rows in the blueprint's cost breakdown.
blueprint.kindPassages: Heading of a group of rows in the blueprint's cost breakdown. A passage is a walkway linking two stations.
blueprint.kindBusRoutes: Heading of a group of rows in the blueprint's cost breakdown.
blueprint.kindBuses: Heading of a group of rows in the blueprint's cost breakdown.
blueprint.count: A counted thing in the blueprint's cost list and hovers. noun: which thing (station, junction, flyover, flatCrossing, newCar, ground, roadCrossing, stationUpgrade, passage, newBus, port, newBoat, other); count: e.g. 3.
blueprint.ferryRoute: Row in the blueprint's cost list for a ferry route. distance: its length, e.g. "12 km".
blueprint.lengthLevel: Row in the blueprint's cost list for track. distance: e.g. "3.7 km"; level: the track's level, e.g. "viaduct (+2)".
blueprint.withLevel: Row in the blueprint's cost list. what: a counted thing such as "2 stations"; level: e.g. "ground (0)".
blueprint.mil: A price in millions of US dollars as the Build tab quotes it. value: e.g. "90" or "1.5".
blueprint.amountUnit: A distance in the price breakdown. value: a number, e.g. "3.7"; unit: "km" or "mi".
blueprint.overWater: Line in the price breakdown hover of a track or station row built over water.
blueprint.baseCostDist: First line of the price hover of a track row. price: e.g. "$75M"; unit: "km" or "mi".
blueprint.length: Line in the price breakdown hover; its amount is the length.
blueprint.roughGround: Line in the price breakdown hover for track over difficult terrain, when the terrain has no name.
blueprint.costFactor: Line in the price breakdown hover: the sum of the level's multiplier and the terrain and water additions.
blueprint.singleTrack: Line in the price breakdown hover for single-track pieces, which cost less.
blueprint.hsrTrack: Line in the price breakdown hover for high-speed track, which costs more.
blueprint.baseCostStation: First line of the price hover of a station row. price: e.g. "$90M"; level: lower case, e.g. "ground level".
blueprint.stationsFactor: Line in the price breakdown hover of a station row with several stations; its amount is how many.
blueprint.platformLength: Line in the price breakdown hover of a station row: the multiplier for platforms longer than the base.
blueprint.junctionTrack: Line in the price breakdown hover of a junction row; its amount is the track length.
blueprint.flyoverTrack: Line in the price breakdown hover of a flyover row; its amount is the track length.
blueprint.crossingTrack: Line in the price breakdown hover of a flat crossing row; its amount is the track length.
blueprint.crossoverTrack: Line in the price breakdown hover: an extra multiplier for crossovers.
blueprint.ferryFree: First line of the price hover of a ferry route row.
blueprint.baseCostPer: First line of the price hover for cars, buses, boats, ports, upgrades and passages. price: the average price of one, e.g. "$2M"; noun: which thing.
blueprint.factorName: Line in the price breakdown hover when more than one of a thing is bought; its amount is how many. noun: which thing; the name is in plural and starts with a capital.
blueprint.factorAdd: Line in the price breakdown hover: something added to the multiplier. name: e.g. "Mountains"; amount: e.g. "2.5".
blueprint.factorSet: Line in the price breakdown hover: the level's multiplier. name: e.g. "Ground level"; amount: e.g. "0.5".
blueprint.factorTimes: Line in the price breakdown hover: a multiplication. name: e.g. "Length" or "Single track"; amount: a number or distance, e.g. "3.7 km" or "0.6".
blueprint.sum: Last line of the price breakdown hover: the total. money: e.g. "$120M".
blueprint.title: Heading of the quote in the Build tab for what is planned but not yet built.
blueprint.totalTip: Hover of the total price in the Build tab.
blueprint.undoTip: Hover of the undo button in the Build tab.
blueprint.undo: Screen-reader label of the undo button in the Build tab.
blueprint.redoTip: Hover of the redo button in the Build tab.
blueprint.redo: Screen-reader label of the redo button in the Build tab.
blueprint.upkeepLead: Start of the hover on the blueprint's daily upkeep line; more text about the upkeep rates follows it, so it ends without a full stop.
blueprint.upkeepDay: Line in the Build tab: what the blueprint will cost each day once built. money: e.g. "$1.2M".
blueprint.constructTip: Hover of the Construct blueprints button. key: its keyboard shortcut, "C".
blueprint.construct: Button in the Build tab that builds everything in the blueprint.
blueprint.trackPieces: Part of a list of blueprint pieces, e.g. "5 track, 2 stations". count: a number of track pieces.
blueprint.offTip: Hover of the disabled-cost figure beside the Build tab's total. pieces: e.g. "5 track, 2 stations"; cost: e.g. "$12M".
blueprint.offCost: Small figure beside the Build tab's total: the price of switched-off blueprint pieces. money: e.g. "$12M".
blueprint.offPiecesTip: Hover of the disabled count in the Build tab. pieces: e.g. "5 track, 2 stations".
blueprint.offCount: Small note in the Build tab: how many blueprint pieces are switched off. count: e.g. "7".
blueprint.doubleUp: First line of the hover on the Double up button in the selection bar. runs: how many runs of double track are selected; price: e.g. "$20M".
blueprint.doubleUpRuns: Second line of the Double up hover.
blueprint.doubleUpSome: Third line of the Double up hover. why: the reasons some runs cannot be doubled.
blueprint.doubleUpLabel: Screen-reader label of the Double up button in the selection bar.
blueprint.piece: What the selection holds. built: true for built pieces; pieces: e.g. "5 track, 2 stations".
blueprint.levelTip: Hover of a level button in the selection bar. level: lower case, e.g. "viaduct"; label: e.g. "+2".
blueprint.selection: Screen-reader label of the selection bar at the top of the map.
blueprint.selectedTip: Hover of the count in the selection bar. piece: a blueprint.piece text.
blueprint.selected: Word after the count of selected pieces in the selection bar, e.g. "5 selected".
blueprint.lengthTip: Hover of the length figure in the selection bar.
blueprint.levelMixed: Hover of the level button in the selection bar when the selected track is at several levels.
blueprint.level: Screen-reader label of the level button in the selection bar.
blueprint.trackType: Screen-reader label of the Regular / High speed button pair in the selection bar.
blueprint.regular: Button in the selection bar: ordinary track.
blueprint.highSpeed: Button in the selection bar: high-speed track.
blueprint.hsrTip: Hover of the High speed button. factor: a number, e.g. 1.5.
blueprint.disableTip: Hover of the Disable button in the selection bar. keyed: true when it has a keyboard shortcut; key: e.g. "E".
blueprint.disable: Button in the selection bar that leaves the selected pieces out when constructing.
blueprint.enableTip: Hover of the Enable button in the selection bar. keyed: true when it has a keyboard shortcut; key: e.g. "E".
blueprint.enable: Button in the selection bar that puts the selected pieces back into construction.
blueprint.removeTip: Hover of the Remove button in the selection bar. keyed: true when the Delete key does the same. Delete is a key name.
blueprint.remove: Button in the selection bar that removes the selected pieces.
blueprint.clearTip: Hover of the Clear button in the selection bar. Esc is a key name.
blueprint.clear: Button in the selection bar that clears the selection.
blueprint.levels: Hover line of a stretch row in the cost breakdown that spans several levels. from and to: level labels, e.g. "-1" and "+2".
blueprint.switchTip: Hover and screen-reader label of a checkbox in the cost breakdown. on: true when the piece is on, so the box would switch it off; what: joined (all the joined track of a part), stretch, or station.
blueprint.breakdown: Heading of the folded list below the Build tab's total.
blueprint.fold: Screen-reader label of a chevron that folds a part of the cost breakdown.
blueprint.unfold: Screen-reader label of a chevron that opens a part of the cost breakdown.
blueprint.crossingsTip: Hover line of a stretch row in the cost breakdown. count: e.g. 2; money: what they cost, e.g. "$3M".
blueprint.byKind: Heading of the folded list of the quote grouped by kind in the cost breakdown.
buildTab.busTip: Hover of the Bus tool button in the Build tab. key: the keyboard shortcut, one capital letter, e.g. "B".
buildTab.bus: Label of the Bus tool button in the Build tab.
buildTab.ferryTip: Hover of the Ferry tool button in the Build tab. key: the keyboard shortcut, one capital letter, e.g. "F".
buildTab.ferry: Label of the Ferry tool button in the Build tab.
busInspector.changeTip: Hover on the Edit route button of a ferry line or a planned bus line.
busInspector.changeTipBuilt: Hover on the Edit route button of a constructed bus line.
busInspector.changing: Row label in a bus or ferry line's past-24-hours rows: riders changing to a train.
busInspector.changingTip: Hover on the Changing to trains row. vehicle: boat or bus.
busInspector.constructed: Notice after constructing a bus or ferry line. name: the line's name; price: "$1.2M"; ferry: true for a ferry line.
busInspector.copy: Button in a bus or ferry line view that copies the line.
busInspector.deleteNo: Button that cancels the delete question for a bus or ferry line.
busInspector.deleteQuestion: Question before deleting a bus line that has stops. name: the line's name; built: true when the route is constructed.
busInspector.deleteYes: Button in a bus or ferry line view that deletes the line, and the confirm button of its delete question.
busInspector.edit: Button in a bus or ferry line view that starts drawing the route again.
busInspector.end: Name given to the end of a bus route that is near no place, and the row label of a route end in the stops list.
busInspector.endTip: Hover on an end of the route in a bus line's stops list.
busInspector.firstStop: Hover on the time beside the first stop of a bus or ferry line.
busInspector.planned: Label in the callout of a bus or ferry line that is only in the blueprint, above its Construct button.
busInspector.port: Stands in for a port with no name in a ferry line's port list.
busInspector.ports: Heading of the ports list in a ferry line view.
busInspector.reached: Hover on the time beside a stop of a bus or ferry line. n: whole minutes, "12".
busInspector.removeStop: Hover on the small hit area beside a port of a ferry line. name: the port's name.
busInspector.save: Button label while a bus or ferry route is being drawn.
busInspector.saveTip: Hover on the Save route button.
busInspector.station: Stands in for a station with no name in a bus line's stops list.
busInspector.stops: Heading of the stops list in a bus line view.
busInspector.streetBetween: Hover on a folded row of street stops in a bus line's stops list. count: 1, 3; from, to: the names of the stops on each side.
busInspector.streetStops: A folded row of street stops in a bus line's stops list, and its fallback hover. count: 1, 3.
busInspector.sub: Line under the title of a bus or ferry line view. ferry: true for a ferry line; count: stops or ports; distance: route length, "12.4 km".
cities.profitTip: First line of the hover on a profit figure in the Cities tab. yesterday: true when it is yesterday's ledger; name: a city name or "all cities"; money: e.g. "$1.2M".
cities.fares: Line of the profit hover. money: the day's fare income, e.g. "$3.4M".
cities.running: Line of the profit hover. money: what running trains cost that day, usually negative, e.g. "-$1.1M".
cities.upkeep: Line of the profit hover. money: upkeep cost that day, e.g. "-$0.3M".
cities.newTrains: Line of the profit hover, shown only when trains were bought. money: e.g. "-$2M".
cities.construction: Line of the profit hover, shown only when something was built. money: e.g. "-$5M".
cities.pointsPast: First line of the hover on a points figure. points: e.g. "1,200"; city: a city name.
cities.pointsRate: Second line of the hover on a points figure. points: e.g. "900"; day: a day-type phrase such as "on an average day" or "on weekdays".
cities.pointsRule: Third line of the hover on a points figure. trip and km: points per trip and per kilometre, e.g. 10 and 2.
cities.pointsPastAll: First line of the hover on the points figure of the All cities row. points: e.g. "1,200".
cities.starTip: Hover of the star beside a city that reached its star goal. when: e.g. "Monday, day 71, at 14:08"; city: a city name; share: e.g. "10".
cities.all: Name of the first row of the Cities tab, which sums every city the player has built in.
cities.allLower: The all-cities row's name in the middle of a sentence, in cities.profitTip.
cities.where: A phrase after "Trips per day" and "train trips per day" in hovers. city: a city name; dayed: true when a day type is chosen; day: a phrase such as "on weekdays".
cities.whereAll: The same phrase for the All cities row. dayed: true when a day type is chosen; day: a phrase such as "on weekdays".
cities.allTip: Hover of the All cities name. The first line is a title. name: "All cities"; cities and stations: counts, e.g. 3 and 41.
cities.rowTip: Hover of a city's name in the Cities tab. The first line is a title. name: a city name; stations: count, e.g. 12.
cities.tripsTip: Hover of the trips figure in the Cities tab. count: e.g. "1.2M"; where: a cities.where or cities.whereAll phrase, e.g. "in Osaka on weekdays".
cities.colName: Column heading of the city name column in the Cities tab.
cities.sortName: Hover of the Name column heading.
cities.colTrain: Column heading of the train share column in the Cities tab.
cities.sortTrain: Hover of the Train column heading.
cities.colTrips: Column heading of the train trips column in the Cities tab.
cities.sortTrips: Hover of the Trips column heading.
cities.colProfit: Column heading of the profit column in the Cities tab.
cities.sortProfit: Hover of the Profit column heading.
cities.colPoints: Column heading of the points column in the Cities tab.
cities.sortPoints: Hover of the Points column heading.
cityDetails.boardingsIn: Unit text after the figures in the By purpose split of the city view. city: the city's name, "Boston".
cityDetails.boardingsToday: Small right-aligned caption on the Top lines and Top stations headings of the city view: the figures below are boardings in the past 24 hours.
cityDetails.byPurpose: Heading in the city view above the split of boardings by trip purpose (commute, shopping and so on).
cityDetails.cities: Row label in the all cities view: how many cities.
cityDetails.goalsReached: Row label in the city view: the goal percentages of train share the player has reached here. The value is a list of marks such as "10%", or cityDetails.none.
cityDetails.lineBoardings: Hover on a row of Top lines in the city view. count: "12k"; line: the line's name, "Line 4"; city: "Boston".
cityDetails.lines: Row label in the city and all cities views: how many lines.
cityDetails.none: Value of the Goals reached row in the city view when no goal is reached yet.
cityDetails.points: Row label in the city and all cities views: score points.
cityDetails.profit: Row label in the city and all cities views: profit per day.
cityDetails.stationBoardings: Hover on a row of Top stations in the city view. count: "12k"; station: the station's name.
cityDetails.stations: Row label in the city and all cities views: how many stations.
cityDetails.topLines: Heading in the city view above its busiest lines.
cityDetails.topStations: Heading in the city view above its busiest stations.
cityDetails.trainShare: Row label in the city and all cities views: the share of trips made by train.
cityDetails.trainTrips: Row label in the city and all cities views: train trips per day.
cityDetails.tripsTip: Hover on the Train trips row of the city view. count: "12,430"; phrase: when the figure is for, such as "per day" or "on Sundays"; city: "Boston".
cityDetails.where: Fragment added to the title of the train share table in the city view. It starts with a space. city: "Boston"; day: empty, or a space and a phrase such as "on Sundays".
cityInspector.calculating: Muted line in the city view while the trips are still being worked out.
cityInspector.car: Name of the car part of a trip mode bar in the city view (hover and legend).
cityInspector.destinationTip: Hover on a row of Top destinations in the city view. count: "12,430"; phrase: "per day" or "on Sundays"; city: "Boston"; place: another city's name.
cityInspector.goTo: Hover and screen-reader label of the locate button in a city view title. city: "Boston".
cityInspector.noInter: Muted note in the city view when the city has no trips to other places.
cityInspector.noRoute: Name of the grey part of the trips-within bar in the city view: trips with no way to make them.
cityInspector.notDrawn: Muted note in the city view when the map is filtered to one trip purpose and the bubbles are not drawn.
cityInspector.partTip: Hover on one part of a trip mode bar in the city view. name: the mode, "Train"; count: "12,430"; kind: within (trips inside the city) or inter (to and from other places); city: "Boston"; phrase: "per day" or "on Sundays"; share: "42%".
cityInspector.plane: Name of the plane part of the to-other-places bar in the city view.
cityInspector.toOther: Row label in the city view: trips between this city and other places.
cityInspector.toOtherTip: Hover on the To other places row of the city view.
cityInspector.topDestinations: Muted heading in the city view above the three biggest places trips go to.
cityInspector.totalTip: Hover on the figure of a trips row in the city view. count: "12,430"; kind: within or inter; city: "Boston"; phrase: "per day" or "on Sundays".
cityInspector.train: Name of the train part of a trip mode bar in the city view.
cityInspector.tripsWithin: Row label in the city view: trips that stay inside the city. city: "Boston".
cityInspector.walk: Name of the walking part of the trips-within bar in the city view.
closestStations.noWalk: Value of a Closest stations row when the station cannot be reached on foot (water in the way).
closestStations.onFoot: Hover on the walking time of a Closest stations row. length: the walking distance, "350 m" or "0.2 mi".
closestStations.title: Heading above the three nearest stations on foot in a station or demand-bubble view.
closestStations.water: Hover on a Closest stations row that has no walk.
colourPicker.area: Screen-reader label of the colour picker's square area, where one axis is saturation and the other brightness.
colourPicker.hue: Screen-reader label of the colour picker's hue strip.
colourPicker.hex: Screen-reader label of the colour picker's text box holding a colour as a hex code such as #3366cc.
commutersInspector.areas: Small line under the title of the commuters view: how many map areas were picked. count: 1, 3.
commutersInspector.driving: Row label in the commuters view: trips made by car.
commutersInspector.legs: Bold row label in the commuters view above the mode rows. phrase: when the figure is for, "per day" or "on Sundays".
commutersInspector.legsTip: Hover on the area count under the title of the commuters view.
commutersInspector.noRoute: Row label in the commuters view: trips with no way to make them.
commutersInspector.only: Muted note in the commuters view when the map is filtered to one trip purpose. purpose: the purpose word, capitalised, "Commute".
commutersInspector.title: Title of the commuters view, opened by clicking a place on the commuter map. end: home (trips starting from homes here), work (trips ending here) or both.
commutersInspector.train: Row label in the commuters view: trips made by train.
commutersInspector.walking: Row label in the commuters view: trips made on foot.
complexMap.boardings: Line of the hover on a platform in the complex map. count: "1.2k".
complexMap.changes: Line of the hover on a platform in the complex map: riders changing from this line. count: "340"; list: up to three destinations with their counts, "Line 2 at Canal St (120), Line 5 (80)".
complexMap.label: Screen-reader label of the small map of a station complex's platforms.
complexMap.lineAt: A line reached at another station of the complex, in the changes list of a platform hover. line: "Line 2"; station: the station's short name.
complexMap.linked: Hover on a link the player drew between two stations of a complex. a, b: station names; length: the distance between them, "120 m".
complexMap.noLines: Line of the hover on a platform in the complex map when no line stops at it.
complexMap.riders: Line of the hover on a platform in the complex map. count: "1.2k".
complexMap.waiting: Last line of the hover on a platform in the complex map. count: people waiting, "14"; room: how many more fit, "80"; oneSide: true when the platform has one side only, otherwise the room is on each of two sides.
constructButton.plain: Button that builds a planned line, before its price is known.
constructButton.priced: Button that builds a planned line. price: the full cost, "$12.4M".
constructButton.tipBoth: Hover on the Construct button when the line also needs vehicles bought. kind: boat, bus or line (a train line); build: the cost of the route or track, "$10M"; trains: the cost of the vehicles, "$2.4M". Reads as two costs then a sentence.
constructButton.tipBuild: Hover on the Construct button when no vehicles need buying. kind: boat, bus or line (a train line); build: the cost, "$10M".
constructButton.tipNone: Hover on the Construct button before the price is known. kind: boat, bus or line (a train line).
credits.title: Heading of the collapsed list of data credits at the foot of Settings.
demandSelector.north: Hover and screen-reader label of the needle button that appears while the map is rotated.
demandSelector.tipNone: Hover of the None button in the map's demand row. key: its keyboard shortcut, one capital letter, e.g. "D".
demandSelector.tipHomes: Hover of the Homes button in the map's demand row. key: its keyboard shortcut, e.g. "D".
demandSelector.tipDestinations: Hover of the Destinations button in the map's demand row. key: its keyboard shortcut, e.g. "D".
demandSelector.tipTotal: Hover of the Total button in the map's demand row. key: its keyboard shortcut, e.g. "D".
demandSelector.nothing: Hover of the greyed demand buttons when the map is over a place with no modeled region.
demandSelector.loading: Hover of the greyed demand buttons while a city's data loads. city: the city's name, e.g. "Osaka"; percent: e.g. "42".
demandSelector.calculating: Hover of the greyed demand buttons while the demand model is working.
demandSelector.group: Screen-reader label of the row of demand buttons (None, Homes, Destinations, Total).
demandSelector.none: Button in the map's demand row and in the station ridership row that turns that display off.
demandSelector.homes: Button in the map's demand row that draws bubbles where people live.
demandSelector.destinations: Button in the map's demand row that draws bubbles where people travel to.
demandSelector.total: Button in the map's demand row, and in the station ridership row, that shows both ends of trips, or all riders.
demandSelector.trackLine: Button in the track display row that colours track by line.
demandSelector.trackLineTip: Hover of the Line button in the track display row.
demandSelector.trackTraffic: Button in the track display row that colours track by line and draws it thicker with more traffic.
demandSelector.trackTrafficTip: Hover of the Traffic button in the track display row.
demandSelector.trackLevel: Button in the track display row that colours track by its level (underground, ground, elevated).
demandSelector.trackLevelTip: Hover of the Level button in the track display row.
demandSelector.trackSpeed: Button in the track display row that colours track by its speed.
demandSelector.trackSpeedTip: Hover of the Speed button in the track display row.
demandSelector.trackProfit: Button in the track display row that colours track by what it earns.
demandSelector.trackProfitTip: Hover of the Profit button in the track display row.
demandSelector.foldBubbles: Hover of the small icon that folds or opens the demand buttons row. shut: true when the row is folded away.
demandSelector.foldStations: Hover of the small icon that folds or opens the station ridership row. shut: true when the row is folded away.
demandSelector.foldTrack: Hover of the small icon that folds or opens the track display row. shut: true when the row is folded away.
demandSelector.origins: Button in the station ridership row that sizes station circles by riders starting a trip there.
demandSelector.originsTip: Hover of the Origins button in the station ridership row.
demandSelector.transfers: Button in the station ridership row that sizes station circles by riders changing lines there.
demandSelector.transfersTip: Hover of the Transfers button in the station ridership row.
demandSelector.totalTip: Hover of the Total button in the station ridership row.
demandSelector.stationGroup: Screen-reader label of the station ridership row of buttons.
demandSelector.trackGroup: Screen-reader label of the track display row of buttons.
demandSelector.purpose: Screen-reader label of the drop-down that narrows the map's demand to one trip purpose.
demandSelector.allPurposes: First option of the trip purpose drop-down on the map.
demandStopped.tip: Hover of the red alert under the demand buttons after the demand model failed. memory: true when it ran out of memory. error: the technical error text, or demandStopped.unknown, e.g. "worker crashed".
demandStopped.unknown: Stands in for the error text in demandStopped.tip when none is known. Lower case, follows "with an error:".
demandStopped.memory: Red alert text under the demand buttons when the demand model ran out of memory.
demandStopped.stopped: Red alert text under the demand buttons when the demand model stopped on an error.
diagramButton.showMap: Hover and screen-reader label of buttons that return from the network diagram to the map.
diagramButton.showDiagram: Hover and screen-reader label of the button at the top of the Cities tab that replaces the map with a schematic diagram of the player's network.
diagramButton.showWater: Hover and screen-reader label of the toggle that shows or hides water on the network diagram.
diagramButton.savePicture: Hover and screen-reader label of the button that saves the network diagram as an image.
diagramButton.calculating: Status text beside the loading bar while the network diagram is being laid out.
dock.build: Name of the Build tab in the dock, shown in its hover and screen-reader label (the tab itself is an icon).
dock.lines: Name of the Lines tab in the dock, shown in its hover.
dock.stations: Name of the Stations tab in the dock, shown in its hover.
dock.finances: Name of the money tab in the dock, shown in its hover.
dock.cities: Name of the Cities tab in the dock, shown in its hover.
dock.tabTip: Hover of a dock tab icon. name: the tab's name (dock.build and so on); key: its keyboard shortcut, e.g. "1".
dock.noStations: Paragraph in the Cities tab while the player has built no stations.
dock.saves: Hover and screen-reader label of the dock button that opens the saved games panel.
dock.settings: Hover and screen-reader label of the dock button that opens the Settings tab.
fareGraph.undoLabel: Screen-reader label of the undo button beside the fare graph's heading in the Finances tab.
fareGraph.undoTip: Hover of the undo button beside the fare graph's heading.
fareGraph.zoomOut: Hover and screen-reader label of the button that shows a longer distance on the fare graph.
fareGraph.zoomIn: Hover and screen-reader label of the button that shows a shorter distance on the fare graph.
fareGraph.baseFare: Label of the first row under the fare graph: the fare for the shortest trip.
fareGraph.baseFareLabel: Screen-reader label of the base fare's stepper.
fareGraph.baseFareTip: Hover of the base fare's typed value.
fareGraph.past: Label of the last fare row under the graph. from: where the last stretch starts, e.g. "120"; unit: "km" or "mi".
fareGraph.stretchEnd: Label of a fare row under the graph: the stretch runs from a distance to an editable distance. from: the start, e.g. "50"; end: an editable box showing the end, e.g. "120"; unit: "km" or "mi". The pieces are set tight together on purpose.
fareGraph.endLabel: Screen-reader label of the editable distance where a fare stretch ends. n: the stretch's number, e.g. 2.
fareGraph.endTip: Hover of the editable distance where a fare stretch ends. unit: "km" or "mi".
fareGraph.rateLabel: Screen-reader label of the stepper for a fare stretch's rate. n: the stretch's number, e.g. 2.
fareGraph.rateTip: Hover of the editable rate of a fare stretch. last: true for the final stretch, which has no end; rate: e.g. "$0.12"; unit: "km" or "mi"; from and to: distances, e.g. "50" and "120".
fareGraph.perUnit: Label after a fare stretch's rate. unit: "km" or "mi".
fareGraph.hoverTip: Hover over the fare graph: the fare at the pointer's distance. distance: e.g. "85"; unit: "km"; fare: e.g. "$4.20".
fareGraph.tickUnit: Last distance label on the fare graph's horizontal axis. value: e.g. "200"; unit: "km" or "mi".
fareGraph.baseNodeTip: Hover of the base fare's knob on the fare graph. The first line is a title. fare: e.g. "$2.00".
fareGraph.nodeTip: Hover of a knob on the fare graph. The first line is a title. distance: e.g. "85"; unit: "km"; fare: e.g. "$4.20".
fareGraph.offTip: Hover of an arrow at the fare graph's edge that stands for a knob outside the view. first: the knob's first hover line, e.g. "300 km: $9.00".
feedbackPanel.unreachable: Error under the feedback form when the server cannot be reached.
feedbackPanel.tooMany: Error under the feedback form when the server refuses because too many messages were sent.
feedbackPanel.wrong: Error under the feedback form for any other failure.
feedbackPanel.open: Button at the foot of Settings that opens the feedback form.
feedbackPanel.empty: Message under the feedback form when Send is pressed with an empty message.
feedbackPanel.thanks: Small note that appears on the map after feedback is sent.
feedbackPanel.failed: Error under the feedback form after a failed send. reason: a sentence such as "Something went wrong. Try again in a minute.".
feedbackPanel.title: Title of the feedback form.
feedbackPanel.namePlaceholder: Placeholder of the name box in the feedback form.
feedbackPanel.nameLabel: Screen-reader label of the name box in the feedback form.
feedbackPanel.emailPlaceholder: Placeholder of the email box in the feedback form.
feedbackPanel.emailLabel: Screen-reader label of the email box in the feedback form.
feedbackPanel.messageLabel: Placeholder and screen-reader label of the message box in the feedback form.
feedbackPanel.sending: Label of the send button while the feedback is being sent.
feedbackPanel.send: Submit button of the feedback form.
goalTicks.when: A moment in the game: weekday name, game day number, clock time. weekday: "Monday"; day: "71"; time: "14:08".
goalTicks.tip: Hover of a goal tick over a city's mode split bar. star: true for the star goal; reached: true when the player has reached it; share: the goal's train share, e.g. "20"; city: the city's name; when: goalTicks.when text such as "Monday, day 71, at 14:08" (empty when not reached).
goalTicks.real: Hover of the real-world marker on a city's mode split bar. share: e.g. "12.3"; city: the city's name; dayed: true when a day type is shown; day: a phrase such as "on weekdays".
groupInspector.addStop: Hover on a place in the group diagram where a line passes without stopping, while the group's stops are edited. line: the line's coloured bullet; station: the station's name.
groupInspector.all: Hover and screen-reader label of the toggle in a group view that lists every stop.
groupInspector.backToColour: Hover and screen-reader label of the button in the group editor that drops the colour chosen by hand.
groupInspector.bullet: Label of the bullet text box in the group editor: the letters shown in the group's pill.
groupInspector.bulletLabel: Screen-reader label of the bullet text box in the group editor.
groupInspector.copy: Hover and screen-reader label of the button in a group view that opens the choice of a line to copy.
groupInspector.copyLine: Hover on a line's chip in the choice of a line to copy. name: the line's name.
groupInspector.fewer: Hover and screen-reader label of the toggle in a group view that lists only the main stops.
groupInspector.noTrains: Hover on the bullet of a line in the group diagram that has no trains now. line: the line's name; demand: inspector.demand.
groupInspector.none: Shown in the group view when the group no longer exists.
groupInspector.passes: Line of the hover on a row of the group diagram: the lines that pass without stopping. list: line names joined by commas.
groupInspector.passesStation: Hover on a place in the group diagram where a line passes a station without stopping. line: the line's coloured bullet; station: the station's name.
groupInspector.removeStop: Hover on a stop in the group diagram while the group's stops are edited. line: the line's coloured bullet; station: the station's name.
groupInspector.shiftEnd: Second line of the remove-stop hover in the group diagram. line: the line's coloured bullet.
groupInspector.stops: Line of the hover on a row of the group diagram: the lines that stop there. list: line names joined by commas.
groupInspector.stopsAt: Hover on a stop in the group diagram. line: the line's name or coloured bullet; station: the station's name.
groupInspector.stopsHeading: Heading of the stops diagram in a group view.
groupInspector.turnsBack: Hover on the end stop of a line in the group diagram. line: the line's coloured bullet; station: the station's name.
guide.counterKm: Progress of a tutorial step measured in kilometres. have and goal: numbers with one decimal, e.g. "3.2" and "5.0".
guide.counterPercent: Progress of a tutorial step measured in percent. have: one decimal, e.g. "3.2"; goal: e.g. "10".
guide.closeQuestion: Text of the confirmation shown when the player closes the tutorial card.
guide.closeYes: Button in the close-tutorial confirmation that closes the card.
guide.closeNo: Button in the close-tutorial confirmation that keeps the card.
guide.title: Heading of the tutorial card at the map's upper right.
guide.close: Screen-reader label of the cross on the tutorial card.
guide.done: Button at the end of the tutorial's last card.
guide.continue: Button at the end of the tutorial's first card that moves on to the second.

hideUi.hint: Reminder at the top of the screen while the interface is hidden for screenshots. key: the key name, e.g. "F2".
homeButton.off: Screen-reader label of the home button when this place is not home.
homeButton.on: Screen-reader label of the home button when this place is home.
homeButton.tipOff: Hover on the home button when this place is not home: a title line, then what making it home does. where: world (the all cities view) or city.
homeButton.tipOn: Hover on the home button when this place is home: a title line, then what it does. where: world (the all cities view) or city.
inspector.blueprint: A station that is planned but not constructed, in the Closest stations list and the complex map hover. name: the station's name.
inspector.cars: A count of train cars in the line and station panels. count: 1, 8.
inspector.demand: The demand level the game is set to, as a lower-case adjective in a sentence such as "at high demand". demand: high, medium or low.
inspector.min: A duration in minutes in the inspector panels. n: whole minutes, "6".
inspector.minShort: A duration in minutes written very short in the stops lists. n: whole minutes, "12".
inspector.noRoadEnds: Second line of the hover on the No route part of a trip bar: why those trips have no route (two land parts no road joins).
inspector.perDay: A rate per day in the inspector panels. value: a formatted figure, "12k" or "$1.2M".
junctionInspector.add: Button in a junction view that adds a flyover to the blueprint.
junctionInspector.addedToBlueprint: Small note beside the flyover button in a junction view that is still a blueprint.
junctionInspector.built: Notice after constructing a flyover. price: "$1.2M".
junctionInspector.busiest: Row label in a junction view: the load of the most used crossing.
junctionInspector.capacity: Value of the Busiest crossing row in a junction view. pct: whole percent, "85%".
junctionInspector.construct: Button in a junction view that builds a flyover for money.
junctionInspector.crosses: Small line under a route in a junction view: the routes it crosses on the level. list: routes joined by commas, "North to East, West to South".
junctionInspector.flyoverTip: Hover on the button that adds or constructs a flyover in a junction view.
junctionInspector.moveTip: Hover on a route in the junction map. route: "North to East" (junctionInspector.route); count: trains per hour, "12"; demand: inspector.demand; crosses: true when the route crosses another on the level.
junctionInspector.noCross: Note in a junction view when no routes through it cross.
junctionInspector.noLine: Note in a junction view when no running line uses the junction.
junctionInspector.none: Value of the Waiting it saves row in a junction view when the flyover would save under a second.
junctionInspector.paidAtOnce: Small note beside the flyover button in a junction view that is already constructed.
junctionInspector.planned: Notice after adding a flyover to the blueprint.
junctionInspector.price: Row label in a junction view: what a flyover costs.
junctionInspector.remove: Button in a junction view that removes a blueprint flyover.
junctionInspector.route: A route through a junction, named by the two ports it joins. from, to: port names, such as a station name or a compass direction.
junctionInspector.routes: Heading in a junction view above the list of routes.
junctionInspector.routesCols: Small right-aligned caption on the Routes heading of a junction view: what the two figure columns are.
junctionInspector.saves: Row label in a junction view: the waiting a flyover would save per train.
junctionInspector.savesFigure: Value of the Waiting it saves row in a junction view. time: "12 s"; demand: inspector.demand.
junctionInspector.sub: Line under the title of a junction view. level: "1"; ports: how many tracks meet, "4"; flying: true when it has a flyover.
junctionInspector.title: Title of the junction view.
junctionInspector.wait: Note in a junction view when routes through it cross on the level.
keepDot.behindTip: Hover of the dot beside the search button when the playing game's latest change has not reached the account. The first line is a title. why: the reason, a sentence such as "You are offline."; retry: true when clicking the dot can help.
keepDot.tipAccount: Hover of the dot beside the search button when the game exists only in this browser and accounts are available. The first line is a title.
keepDot.tipDownload: Hover of the dot beside the search button when the game exists only in this browser and there is no account server. The first line is a title.
keepDot.label: Screen-reader label of the dot beside the search button.
leaderboard.valueTip: Hover of a score in a leaderboard row. points: a number, e.g. "1,200"; world: true on the world board; city: the city's name on a city board, e.g. "Osaka".
leaderboard.sandbox: Note at the foot of the leaderboards while a sandbox game is being played.
leaderboard.signIn: Button at the foot of the leaderboards, for a signed-out player, that opens the account panel.
leaderboard.leave: Button at the foot of the leaderboards that removes the player's name from them.
leaderboard.name: Placeholder and screen-reader label of the box where the player types the name shown on the leaderboards.
leaderboard.join: Button that puts the player on the leaderboards under the typed name.
leaderboard.pick: Screen-reader label of the drop-down that picks which leaderboard to show.
leaderboard.world: Option of the leaderboard drop-down for the worldwide board.
leaderboard.thisGame: Group heading in the leaderboard drop-down for the cities the current game has points in.
leaderboard.otherCities: Group heading in the leaderboard drop-down for all other cities with a board.
leaderboard.loading: Shown in the leaderboards while the rows load.
leaderboard.nobody: Shown in the leaderboards when a board has no rows.
leaderboard.title: Title of the leaderboards panel, and hover and screen-reader label of the trophy button that opens it.
lineGroup.leave: Hover and screen-reader label of the button that takes a line out of its group.
lineGroup.open: Hover on a group's bullet in a line view.
lineGroup.openNamed: Hover on a group's bullet in a line view when the bullet shows the name shortened: the full name, then the action. name: the group's name.
lineGroup.partOf: Row in a line view when the line is in a group. group: the group's bullet (a coloured pill, clickable), so the sentence reads "Part of [A] group".
lineInspector.add: Button in a line view while its stops are edited that adds the passed stations as stops. stations: a count with its noun, "2 stations".
lineInspector.addTip: Hover on the button that adds the passed stations between two stops. names: the station names as a list, "A and B".
lineInspector.andMore: A shortened list of names. list: the first names joined by commas, "A, B, C"; count: how many more there are, 2.
lineInspector.behindLine: Name of a place where a line loses time, in the round trip rows of a line view: it follows slower trains of another line. line: the other line's name.
lineInspector.behindSlower: Row label and place name in the round trip rows of a line view: time spent following slower trains.
lineInspector.broken: Alert in a line view when a track it used has been removed.
lineInspector.busyTrack: Row label in the round trip rows of a line view: time lost waiting for track in use.
lineInspector.cancel: Button in a line view that drops the stations picked to add as stops.
lineInspector.carry: Hover on the train length figure of a line view. cars: a count with its noun, "8 cars"; rated: riders at the normal load, "1,280"; crush: riders at the most, "1,920".
lineInspector.constructed: Notice after constructing a rail line. name: the line's name; price: "$12M".
lineInspector.copySchedule: Screen-reader label of the button in a line view that copies the line's schedule.
lineInspector.copyScheduleTip: Hover on the button that copies the line's schedule. text: a short description of the schedule.
lineInspector.deleteQuestion: Question before deleting a rail line. name: the line's name.
lineInspector.dwell: Row label in the round trip rows of a line view: time standing at stops.
lineInspector.editStops: Button label in a line view that starts editing the line's stops.
lineInspector.editTip: Hover on the Edit stops button. S is the keyboard shortcut.
lineInspector.expand: Button under a train length the platforms cannot fit, that lengthens the platforms. one: true when one station needs it; priced: true when it costs money; price: "$1.2M".
lineInspector.expandTip: Hover on the Expand button. count: stations to lengthen; names: their names as a list; length: the new platform length, "200 m"; cars: the new train length, "10 cars".
lineInspector.extraCars: Line of the Expand hover: the cars the longer trains need. price: "$1.2M".
lineInspector.fastTip: Hover on the High speed choice of a line view.
lineInspector.fasterTrains: Row label in the round trip rows of a line view: time standing at passing tracks.
lineInspector.finishTip: Hover on the Edit stops button while stops are being edited. S is the keyboard shortcut.
lineInspector.fits: Hover on the Train length label: the shortest platform limits the train. length: "200 m"; name: the station's name; cars: "10 cars".
lineInspector.flatCrossing: Hover on a mark in a line view's stops list where the route crosses other track on the level. hasNear: true when a station is near; near: its name; hasOthers: true when other lines use the crossing; list: their names joined by commas.
lineInspector.flatJunction: Hover on a mark in a line view's stops list where the route joins other track on the level. hasNear: true when a station is near; near: its name; hasOthers: true when other lines use it; list: their names joined by commas.
lineInspector.free: Line of the Expand hover: platforms in the blueprint cost nothing.
lineInspector.heldLevel: Detail line under a capacity alert in a line view. level: High, Medium or Low; text: how long trains are held, from the capacity wording.
lineInspector.hideRelated: Hover and screen-reader label of the toggle in a line view that stops drawing the lines related to this one.
lineInspector.highSpeed: Choice in a line view for the line's kind of train.
lineInspector.lap: Bold row label in the round trip rows of a loop line: the time of one lap.
lineInspector.lineNum: Name for a line that has none, in a flat crossing hover. num: the line's number.
lineInspector.normal: Choice in a line view for the line's kind of train.
lineInspector.normalTip: Hover on the Normal choice of a line view.
lineInspector.openLoop: Hover on the button that removes the last stop of a loop line, opening the loop.
lineInspector.passed: Button in a line view while its stops are edited, for stations the line passes without stopping. stations: a count with its noun, "2 stations".
lineInspector.passingAdded: Notice after adding passing tracks to the blueprint. stations: a count with its noun, "2 stations".
lineInspector.passingBuilt: Notice after building passing tracks. stations: a count with its noun; price: "$1.2M"; extra: true when the change also bought trains; trains: their cost.
lineInspector.passingButton: Button under the round trip rows of a line view. stations: a count with its noun, "2 stations"; priced: true when it costs money; price: "$1.2M".
lineInspector.passingTip: Hover on the Add passing tracks button. names: the station names as a list.
lineInspector.pasteCut: Second line of the Paste the schedule hover. name: the station's name; cars: the copied train length, "10 cars"; cap: what fits, "8 cars".
lineInspector.pasteNone: Hover on the disabled Paste the schedule button.
lineInspector.pasteSchedule: Screen-reader label of the button in a line view that pastes a copied schedule.
lineInspector.pasteScheduleTip: Hover on the Paste the schedule button. from: the line copied; text: a short description of the schedule.
lineInspector.reach: First line of the hover on a stop's time in a line view. speed: "120 km/h".
lineInspector.removeStop: Screen-reader label of the button that removes a stop while stops are edited. name: the station's name.
lineInspector.reverseTip: Hover on the U-turn mark of a stop where trains reverse. time: "2m00s".
lineInspector.reversing: Row label in the round trip rows of a line view: time reversing at stops in the middle.
lineInspector.ridersUnit: Unit text after the percents in the purpose split of a line view, as in purposeSplit.words: "Commute: 42% of riders".
lineInspector.roundTrip: Bold row label in the round trip rows of a line view: the time of a round trip.
lineInspector.running: Row label in the round trip rows of a line view: time spent moving.
lineInspector.shiftEnd: Second line of the remove-stop hover in a line view.
lineInspector.showRelated: Hover and screen-reader label of the toggle in a line view that draws the lines related to this one.
lineInspector.spotAt: Name of a place where a line loses time, in the round trip rows. name: the station's name.
lineInspector.spotPlace: Name of a place where a line loses time, in the round trip rows. kind: junction, crossing, merge or track; hasNear: true when a station is near; near: its name.
lineInspector.stopEditing: Button label in a line view while its stops are being edited.
lineInspector.stops: Heading of the stops list in a rail line view.
lineInspector.stretch: Hover on a stretch of the stops diagram in the Traffic view. from, to: stop names; count: riders, "12,400"; phrase: "per day" or "on Sundays"; filtered: true when the map shows one trip purpose; purpose: its name.
lineInspector.sub: Line under the title of a rail line view. fast: true for a high-speed line; count: stops; distance: route length, "12.4 km".
lineInspector.takeOut: Hover on the button that removes a stop while stops are edited.
lineInspector.tooClose: Last line of the hover on a stop's time: the train never reaches the top speed between the stops.
lineInspector.tooShort: Muted line under the train length when platforms are too short. count: stations; to: the train length wanted, 10.
lineInspector.trainLength: Row label in a line view: how many cars a train has.
lineInspector.trainLengthLabel: Screen-reader label of the train length stepper.
lineInspector.trains: Row label in a line view beside the Normal and High speed choice.
lineInspector.turnEnd: Row label in the round trip rows of a loop line: time turning round at the one end.
lineInspector.turnEnds: Row label in the round trip rows of a line view: time turning round at the two ends.
lineInspector.waitSpot: Name of a place where a line waits for faster trains, in the round trip rows. name: the station's name; faster: true when faster lines are known; list: their names as a list, "Express and Local".
lineInspector.why: Second line of the hover on a stop's time in a line view: what limits the speed. why: top, track, curve or crossover; speed: "120 km/h".
linesTab.planned: Word in a line's row in the Lines tab when the line is drawn but has no trains yet.
linesTab.broken: Word in a line's row in the Lines tab when the line cannot run, for example because its route is cut.
linesTab.pendingTip: Hover of the riders figure of a line while its riders are worked out again.
linesTab.ridersTip: Hover of a line's riders figure in the Lines tab. count: e.g. "12.3k".
linesTab.vehiclesTip: Hover of a bus or ferry line's vehicles figure. period: the time of day, e.g. "Morning peak"; vehicles: e.g. "3 buses".
linesTab.groupRidersTip: Hover of a group's riders figure. count: e.g. "45k"; lines: one row per line, each "Name: figure", separated by line breaks.
linesTab.groupProfitTip: Hover of a group's money figure. money: e.g. "$1.2M"; lines: one row per line, each "Name: amount", separated by line breaks.
linesTab.groupTrainsTip: Hover of a group's trains figure. period: the time of day, e.g. "Morning peak"; count: e.g. 8; lines: one row per line, each "Name: count", separated by line breaks.
linesTab.ridersToday: Small note at the foot of the Lines tab. count: riders on all lines in the past 24 hours, e.g. "120k".
linesTab.cityTip: Hover of the city column of a line in the Lines tab. city: a city name.
linesTab.closeGroup: Hover and screen-reader label of the chevron on an open group of lines.
linesTab.openGroup: Hover and screen-reader label of the chevron on a closed group of lines.
linesTab.groupName: Screen-reader label of the box where a group of lines is renamed.
linesTab.newLineTip: Hover of the New line button in the Lines tab. key: its keyboard shortcut, "N".
linesTab.newLine: Button in the Lines tab that starts a new train line.
linesTab.newBusTip: Hover of the new bus line button in the Lines tab. key: its keyboard shortcut, "U".
linesTab.newBus: Screen-reader label of the new bus line button in the Lines tab.
linesTab.newFerryTip: Hover of the new ferry line button in the Lines tab. key: its keyboard shortcut, "O".
linesTab.newFerry: Screen-reader label of the new ferry line button in the Lines tab.
linesTab.none: Shown in the Lines tab when the game has no lines at all.
linesTab.noneHere: Shown in the Lines tab when there are lines but none in the viewed place.
linesTab.colName: Column heading of the line name column in the Lines tab.
linesTab.sortName: Hover of the Name column heading in the Lines tab.
linesTab.colCity: Column heading of the city column in the Lines tab.
linesTab.sortCity: Hover of the City column heading in the Lines tab.
linesTab.colRiders: Column heading of the riders column in the Lines tab.
linesTab.sortRiders: Hover of the Riders column heading in the Lines tab.
linesTab.colMoney: Column heading of the profit column in the Lines tab.
linesTab.sortMoney: Hover of the Money column heading in the Lines tab.
linesTab.colTrains: Column heading of the trains column in the Lines tab.
linesTab.sortTrains: Hover of the Trains column heading in the Lines tab.
linesTab.colNear: Column heading of the distance column in the Lines tab, shown while sorting by distance.
linesTab.sortNear: Hover of the Near column heading in the Lines tab.
lineTitle.edit: Hover and screen-reader label of the line badge button in a line view title; it opens the editor.
lineTitle.show: Hover and screen-reader label of the locate button in a line view title.
lineTitle.symbol: Label of the symbol input in the line editor: the letter or sign shown in the line's badge.
lineTitle.symbolLabel: Screen-reader label of the symbol input in the line editor.
listParts.near: Hover on the distance column of the Lines and Stations lists. distance: a short distance, e.g. "1.2 km".
listParts.noLines: Hover on the place button above the Lines and Stations lists when the viewed place has no lines. name: a city or region, e.g. "Osaka".
listParts.nothingHere: Hover on the disabled place button above the Lines and Stations lists when the map is over a place the game has no data for.
listParts.only: Hover on the place button above the Lines and Stations lists: the list is limited to the viewed place. name: a city or region, e.g. "Osaka".
listParts.world: Globe button above the Lines and Stations lists: shows every place, not only the one in view. Hover and screen reader name.
loadingScreen.demandTimeout: Message on the loading failure screen when nothing has moved for a long while and the game had started. time: loadingScreen.minutes, e.g. "3 minutes".
loadingScreen.loaded: Hover on the loading bar: two lines. pct: percent done, e.g. 42; step: the stage being loaded, e.g. "Loading demand".
loadingScreen.minutes: A length of time, used inside loadingScreen.demandTimeout and loadingScreen.simTimeout. count: 3.
loadingScreen.pageStopped: Message on the loading failure screen after an error while the game was starting. reason: the browser's error text, e.g. "Script error." (stays in English).
loadingScreen.playWithoutDemand: Button on the screen shown when the demand figures fail to load. Starts the game with no passenger demand.
loadingScreen.seconds: A length of time, used inside loadingScreen.demandTimeout and loadingScreen.simTimeout. count: 30.
loadingScreen.simTimeout: Message on the loading failure screen when the train simulation never started. time: loadingScreen.minutes, e.g. "3 minutes".
loadingScreen.tryAgain: Button on the screen shown when loading fails. Reloads the page.
mareyChart.close: Hover on the cross button of the timetable chart.
mareyChart.closeLabel: Screen-reader label of the cross button of the timetable chart.
mareyChart.hide: Hover and screen-reader label of the schedule heading button while the timetable chart is open.
mareyChart.label: Screen-reader label of the timetable chart panel. line: the line's name, "Line 4".
mareyChart.show: Hover and screen-reader label of the schedule heading button while the timetable chart is closed.
mareyChart.tip: Hover on one train's path in the timetable chart. from, to: the end stations' names; leave, arrive: clock times, "7:42 AM".
marketTrip.accessTip: Hover of the first row of an inter-city train route (getting to the first station). min: 12 min.
marketTrip.airDollarWeight: Last line of the plane's effective time hover. w: 1.5.
marketTrip.airFareTip: Hover of the plane trip's fare row. fare: $50. rate: 12 cents per km.
marketTrip.airportDrives: Row label in the plane section of the inter-city panel: minutes driving to and from the airports.
marketTrip.airportDrivesTip: Hover of the plane trip's airport drives row. from, to: 25 min.
marketTrip.andOthers: Name of a group of far ends in the inter-city panel. place: Philadelphia. count: 2. whole: true when the ends are whole places, false when they are 6 km areas.
marketTrip.atAirports: Row label in the plane section: minutes at the airports.
marketTrip.atAirportsTip: Hover of the plane trip's time-at-airports row.
marketTrip.betweenPlaces: Heading of the trips by mode between two places in the inter-city panel.
marketTrip.bothWays: Ends a trips phrase in the inter-city panel's hovers, for trips between two places in both directions.
marketTrip.byPlane: Heading of the plane section of the inter-city panel.
marketTrip.centsPer: A price per distance in a hover of the inter-city trip panel. cents: 12. unit: km or mile.
marketTrip.commuteOf: Phrase ending 'of' in the mode hovers under Commutes. amount: 12k. who: a phrase such as 'between the two ends, both ways'.
marketTrip.commuteTip: Hover of the legs count in the Commutes heading. amount: 12,400. day: on weekdays. who: a phrase such as 'between the two ends, both ways'.
marketTrip.commutes: Heading of the commutes by mode between two zones.
marketTrip.count: Summary line of the inter-city panel. kind: total (all kinds of trips), inter (inter-city trips only), under (less than one trip). amount: 312k.
marketTrip.crossingLabel: Row label for a crossing on a car trip in the inter-city panel. kind: channel (the English Channel by Le Shuttle or ferry), tsugaru (Aomori to Hakodate), or any other car ferry.
marketTrip.crossingTip: Hover of a crossing row on a car trip. kind: channel, tsugaru or ferry. usd: $150. people: 2. min: 60. hours: 4. distance: 35 km. wait: 90 min.
marketTrip.dollarWeight: Last line of the car's effective time hover in the inter-city panel. w: 1.5.
marketTrip.driveRouted: Hover of the Drive row of a car trip between places. road: 320 km.
marketTrip.driveRule: Hover of the Drive row of a car trip when the road is estimated. road: 320 km. speed: 80 km/h. detour: 1.3. fixed: 10.
marketTrip.egressTip: Hover of the last row of an inter-city train route (leaving the last station). min: 12 min.
marketTrip.everyUser: Note under the train section when the main route carries all the train riders. cities: true when the ends are whole cities.
marketTrip.everyday: Heading of the everyday trips (errands, visits, school, medical) by mode between two neighbouring areas.
marketTrip.everydayOf: Phrase ending 'of' in the mode hovers under Everyday trips. amount: 12k.
marketTrip.everydayTip: Hover of the legs count in the Everyday trips heading. amount: 12,400. day: a phrase such as 'on weekdays'.
marketTrip.flight: Row label in the plane section: minutes in the air.
marketTrip.flightTip: Hover of the plane trip's flight row. distance: 900 km. speed: 800 km/h. fixed: 30. direct: true when a direct flight exists. oneHour: true when a change adds exactly an hour. minutes: 90.
marketTrip.from: Last row of an inter-city train route. station: the last station's name (clickable).
marketTrip.interCity: Heading of the inter-city trips by mode when commutes or everyday trips are shown too.
marketTrip.interCityPeriod: Caption at the right of the train heading. period: morning peak.
marketTrip.kindCount: One entry of the hover's list of what the trips are. amount: 9k.
marketTrip.legsCount: Caption at the right of a heading: how many trip legs (one way of a round trip). amount: 312k.
marketTrip.longerTip: Hover of the summary line and the Inter-city trips heading. amount: 12,400. day: a phrase such as 'on weekdays'. where: 'between the two ends, both ways'.
marketTrip.noRail: Shown in the inter-city panel under the train heading when the train is not offered. why: farClosed (the far end is closed), unmatched (no homes there), or noRail.
marketTrip.noRoad: Shown in the car section of the inter-city panel when no road links the places.
marketTrip.noStation: Shown in the inter-city panel under the train heading when some ends have no station. kind: one (a single end has none), either (both ends have none), many. place: a place name. count: how many more ends have none.
marketTrip.of: Phrase ending 'of' in the inter-city mode hovers ('Train: 45% of ...'). counted: true when at least half a trip is counted. amount: 9k. day: a phrase such as 'on weekdays'.
marketTrip.pairOf: Phrase ending 'of' in the mode hovers under 'Between the two places' ('Train: 45% of ...'). amount: 12k.
marketTrip.pairTip: Hover of the trips count in the heading 'Between the two places'. amount: 12,400. day: a phrase such as 'on weekdays'. a, b: place names.
marketTrip.pairsTip: Hover of the note on the main route's share. n: 12.
marketTrip.parkingTip: Hover of the Parking row of a car trip. people: 2.
marketTrip.partOf: Name of one 6 km area of a place in the inter-city panel. place: Philadelphia.
marketTrip.partsOf: Name of a group of 6 km areas of one place in the inter-city panel. count: 3. place: Philadelphia.
marketTrip.periodTip: Hover of a row in the train share by period list of the inter-city panel. period: Morning peak. amount: 12,400. share: 45%.
marketTrip.possible: Row label: the share of trips the train can serve.
marketTrip.repTip: Hover of the caption at the right of the train heading. period: morning peak. picked: true when the player picked the period.
marketTrip.rivalRow: Row label: the effective time by car or plane on the trips the train can serve.
marketTrip.rivalTip: Hover of the row comparing the train with the car or plane.
marketTrip.routeTip: Hover of a route row in the list of other routes of the inter-city panel. names: Red Line then Blue Line. from, to: station names. share: 12.3%. counted: a clause such as ', 12% of the 312k counted here' or empty. time: 95 min.
marketTrip.running: Row label in the car section of the inter-city panel: fuel and tolls in dollars.
marketTrip.runningTip: Hover of the Running costs row. rate: 12 cents per km. people: 2.
marketTrip.shareUsers: Note under the train section. share: 78%. cities: true when the ends are whole cities.
marketTrip.stationTip: Hover of the Time row of an inter-city train route. terms: 'wait 12 + ride 80 + walk between stations 3'. total: 95 min.
marketTrip.straightCenters: Hover of the distance line when the far end is closed.
marketTrip.to: First row of an inter-city train route. station: the first station's name (clickable).
marketTrip.totalTip: Hover of the summary line when commutes or everyday trips are counted too. amount: 12,400. day: on weekdays. where: 'between the two ends, both ways'. parts: '9k inter-city trips, 3k commute legs'.
marketTrip.trainOthersTip: Hover of the caption at the right of the train heading. period: morning peak. picked: true when the player picked the period.
marketTrip.tripsCount: Caption at the right of a heading: how many trips. amount: 312k.
marketTrip.untilFlight: Row label in the plane section: minutes waiting for a flight.
marketTrip.untilFlightTip: Hover of the plane trip's wait row.
marketTrip.whereAveraged: Last line of the car's effective time hover: what the figure is averaged over.
marketTrip.whereCenters: Last line of the car's effective time hover: what the figure is measured between.
marketTrip.whereFrom: Ends a trips phrase in the inter-city panel's hovers. far: Philadelphia.
marketTrip.whereTo: Ends a trips phrase in the inter-city panel's hovers. far: Philadelphia.
marketTrip.whoHome: Ends a commutes phrase in the inter-city panel's hovers. far: Philadelphia.
marketTrip.whoWork: Ends a commutes phrase in the inter-city panel's hovers. far: Philadelphia.
modal.close: Screen reader name of the X button on every centred panel (saved games, account, leaderboards).
modal.closeTip: Hover on the X button of every centred panel. Esc is the Escape key.
moneyHistory.allCities: In moneyHistory.title and moneyHistory.ridesTitle, where the scope is the whole network rather than one city: "Revenue and expenses in all cities".
moneyHistory.construction: Line in the hover on a bar of the Money tab's history chart, one part of the one-off costs. amount: negative money, e.g. "-$6,000".
moneyHistory.expenses: The coloured word inside moneyHistory.title: the red bars. Starts lowercase in English because it follows "and".
moneyHistory.fares: Line in the hover on a bar of the Money tab's history chart. amount: money, e.g. "$3,400", with "/day" when the column is an average.
moneyHistory.history: Heading of the history section of the Money tab.
moneyHistory.loan: Line in the hover on a bar of the Money tab's history chart: loan repayments. amount: negative money, e.g. "-$500".
moneyHistory.newTrains: Line in the hover on a bar of the Money tab's history chart, one part of the one-off costs. amount: negative money, e.g. "-$2,000".
moneyHistory.oneOff: Line in the hover on a bar of the Money tab's history chart: new trains plus construction. amount: negative money, e.g. "-$8,000".
moneyHistory.perDay: Appended to a money figure or count in the Money tab's history charts when a column covers several days and shows a daily average. Example: "$1,200/day".
moneyHistory.revenue: The coloured word inside moneyHistory.title: the blue bars.
moneyHistory.rides: Line in the hover on a bar of the train rides chart. count: a number of rides, e.g. "12,400", with "/day" when the column is an average.
moneyHistory.ridesTitle: Title above the second history chart. where: a city name, or moneyHistory.allCities.
moneyHistory.running: Line in the hover on a bar of the Money tab's history chart: running plus upkeep. amount: negative money, e.g. "-$1,200".
moneyHistory.runningTrains: Line in the hover on a bar of the Money tab's history chart, one part of the running costs. amount: negative money, e.g. "-$900".
moneyHistory.soFar: Heading line of a history chart hover for the day or hour still in progress. when: a date, a date range or a date and hour, e.g. "Mon Apr 14".
moneyHistory.span1d: Button in the Money tab history's span switch: the past 24 hours, by hour. d is day.
moneyHistory.span30d: Button in the Money tab history's span switch: the past 30 days, by day.
moneyHistory.spanAll: Button in the Money tab history's span switch: every day kept.
moneyHistory.title: Title above the first history chart. revenue: moneyHistory.revenue and expenses: moneyHistory.expenses, each coloured to match its bars; where: a city name, or moneyHistory.allCities.
moneyHistory.upkeep: Line in the hover on a bar of the Money tab's history chart, one part of the running costs. amount: negative money, e.g. "-$300".
moneyTab.backTo: Hover on the undo button beside a fare multiple. value: the multiple it returns to, e.g. "1.00x".
moneyTab.backToDefault: Screen reader name of the undo button beside a country's fare multiple.
moneyTab.backToUsual: Screen reader name of the undo button beside the high speed or ferry fare multiple.
moneyTab.boatTip: Hover on the Boats owned row. price: money, e.g. "$3M"; rule: a cost rule, e.g. "$60 per boat-km"; port: money, e.g. "$20M".
moneyTab.boatsBought: Hover on the number of boats owned. boats: a count with its noun, e.g. "3 boats"; price: money, e.g. "$3M"; total: money, e.g. "$9M".
moneyTab.boatsCost: Last line of the hover on the Running trains row, when the network has boats. rule: a cost rule, e.g. "$60 per boat-km".
moneyTab.boatsNeeded: Row label in the Money tab's fleet list.
moneyTab.boatsOwned: Row label in the Money tab's fleet list.
moneyTab.boatsSpare: Row label in the Money tab's fleet list.
moneyTab.borrow: Row label in the Money tab's loan section, beside three amount buttons.
moneyTab.borrowTip: Hover on a Borrow amount button. amount: money, e.g. "$1B"; payment: money, e.g. "$40M"; days: 30.
moneyTab.borrowed: Row label in the Money tab's loan section: the amount of the loan taken.
moneyTab.boughtAll: Hover on the New trains row of the Money tab when the network has buses and boats.
moneyTab.boughtBoats: Hover on the New trains row of the Money tab when the network has boats.
moneyTab.boughtBuses: Hover on the New trains row of the Money tab when the network has buses.
moneyTab.built: Row label in the Money tab: the value of what the player has constructed.
moneyTab.busTip: Hover on the Buses owned row. price: money, e.g. "$500k"; rule: a cost rule, e.g. "$40 per bus-km"; route: a cost rule for building a bus route, e.g. "$1M per km".
moneyTab.busesBought: Hover on the number of buses owned. buses: a count with its noun, e.g. "12 buses"; price: money, e.g. "$500k"; total: money, e.g. "$6M".
moneyTab.busesCost: Second line of the hover on the Running trains row, when the network has buses. rule: a cost rule, e.g. "$40 per bus-km".
moneyTab.busesNeeded: Row label in the Money tab's fleet list.
moneyTab.busesOwned: Row label in the Money tab's fleet list.
moneyTab.busesSpare: Row label in the Money tab's fleet list.
moneyTab.carTip: Hover on the Cars owned row. price: money, e.g. "$2M"; rule: a cost rule, e.g. "$300 per car-km".
moneyTab.carsBought: Hover on the number of cars owned. count: 120; price: money, e.g. "$2M"; total: money, e.g. "$240M".
moneyTab.carsNeeded: Row label in the Money tab's fleet list: the cars the running lines call for.
moneyTab.carsOwned: Row label in the Money tab's fleet list. A car is one rail vehicle of a train.
moneyTab.carsSpare: Row label in the Money tab's fleet list: cars owned beyond what the lines need.
moneyTab.cash: Row label at the top of the Money tab: the money on hand.
moneyTab.construction: Row label of the Money tab's ledger: the cost of building track and stations.
moneyTab.countryFares: Row label in the Money tab's fare list: the fare multiple for one country. name: a country name, e.g. "Japan".
moneyTab.countryFaresTip: Hover on the country fare multiple's number field. name: a country name, e.g. "Japan".
moneyTab.daysLeft: Row label in the Money tab's loan section: days until the loan is paid off.
moneyTab.fare: Heading of the fare graph section in the Money tab.
moneyTab.fareImpact: Hover on the figures of the Riders per day and Fares per day rows under the fare graph.
moneyTab.fareScale: Screen reader name of the stepper that sets a country's fare multiple.
moneyTab.fares: Row label of the Money tab's ledger: income from fares.
moneyTab.faresPerDay: Row label under the fare graph: the estimated change in fare income from the fare being edited.
moneyTab.ferry: Row label in the Money tab's fare list: the fare multiple for ferry lines.
moneyTab.ferryFare: Screen reader name of the stepper that sets the ferry fare multiple.
moneyTab.ferryTip: Hover on the Ferry fare row and its number field.
moneyTab.hsCarTip: Hover on the High-speed cars owned row. price: money, e.g. "$4M"; rule: a cost rule, e.g. "$500 per car-km".
moneyTab.hsCarsOwned: Row label in the Money tab's fleet list.
moneyTab.hsCarsRunning: Hover on the number of high-speed cars owned. count: how many the lines need, e.g. "48".
moneyTab.hsCarsSpare: Row label in the Money tab's fleet list.
moneyTab.hsr: Row label in the Money tab's fare list: the fare multiple for high speed lines.
moneyTab.hsrFare: Screen reader name of the stepper that sets the high speed fare multiple.
moneyTab.hsrTip: Hover on the High speed fare row and its number field.
moneyTab.interest: Hover on the loan's payment per day. rate: a percentage without the sign, e.g. "0.5".
moneyTab.ledgerLoan: Row label of the Money tab's ledger: loan repayments.
moneyTab.loan: Heading of the loan section at the bottom of the Money tab.
moneyTab.loanFirst: Hover on a disabled Borrow button, before the game has a full day of fares. amount: billions of US dollars, e.g. "1".

moneyTab.loanTerm: Hover on the Loan row of the Money tab's ledger. days: the loan's length, e.g. 30.
moneyTab.net: Last row of the Money tab's ledger: the day's total.
moneyTab.newTrains: Row label of the Money tab's ledger: the cost of vehicles bought.
moneyTab.paymentPerDay: Row label in the Money tab's loan section.
moneyTab.regionSplit: Hover on the place button above the Money tab's ledger: how a region's money is counted.
moneyTab.repay: Button in the Money tab's loan section: pays off the whole loan.
